acceptance_condition: Construct or select task strata scored by number of required complementary knowledge/fact units (verified by ablating information given to single agents), then test the communication-condition x stratum interaction at matched compute with adequate power for the interaction, not just main effects.
rationale: Zhang's own boundary claim ('===== PDF PAGE 14 =====') is that current benchmarks need only a single knowledge point, so MAD may be unnecessary there; if true, the headline negative result is task-topology-confounded and the root note must stratify by knowledge-requirement rather than treat the null as universal.
text: Does the MAD-vs-SC ordering reverse on tasks that genuinely require combining multiple, distributed knowledge points, as Zhang conjectures but never tests?
